report:
Fresh review of the complete diagnostic_counts claim, eight ordinary implementation entries and ten associated ordinary tests. No TODO/N/A evidence is associated. Inspected current captured implementation/test fragments and captured the vendored Salsa accumulated_by traversal needed to substantiate repeated-demand behavior. This was source assessment only: no source edits, build or test suites executed; no claim of new test execution.

Collection and multiplicity: parse/mod.rs preserves malformed or unsupported enabled syntax as Error items. observe.rs traverses the local crate, emits parse/error and incomplete-expansion diagnostics, demands signatures and supported bodies, retains body diagnostics, and explicitly asks local imports for diagnostics even without reference sites. local_syms/uses.rs reports unresolved imports. check/sig.rs Check::report emits a SignatureDiagnostic snapshot via the accumulator as well as its local diagnostic vector; diagnostic.rs defines the accumulator and appends reports without equality-based deduplication. collect gathers the check_crate accumulator once and does not separately append signature vectors. The captured vendored Salsa implementation traverses dependencies with a visited set keyed by query identity, so multiple callers of one signature query do not repeat its accumulated outputs. This is query-identity suppression, not message/location suppression. Distinct reported events stay distinct. Body/parse/import diagnostics are collected in traversal order. compile/mod.rs prepares both compiler results and propagates source-diagnostic mismatches before expectation assertions; ordinary source errors are not rejected merely because rustc exits with a normal error result.

Exact matching: annotations.rs preserves each ERROR/WARN marker in its vector, including successive markers targeting the same source line. observe.rs filters applicability per compiler, builds every eligible marker-to-diagnostic edge using severity and primary file/line locations, and runs augmenting-path matching with reassignment. Diagnostic indices remain distinct even when all contents are equal. Every marker must be assigned and every diagnostic slot must be occupied; missing, excess, severity-incompatible or locationless diagnostics therefore fail. The diagnostic slice is borrowed immutably and is not reordered. Early failure after an unmatchable prefix is valid because any complete matching would restrict to a matching of that prefix. Matching runs before snapshot comparison, so matching rendered text cannot excuse a count error.

Rustc counterpart: rustc.rs parses each top-level diagnostic JSON event into a separate vector entry, ignores only presentation summaries/failure notes, and does not count child notes or secondary labels as new events. Duplicate top-level messages remain separate. It extracts primary/ancestry locations then uses the same complete matcher. Its execution validation accepts the normal compiler error exit with emitted errors; malformed source remains a supported negative fixture. Other malformed process output remains an infrastructure failure as appropriate.

All ten test entries were read, including their local helpers present in captured whole files. incomplete_expansion_is_a_source_diagnostic requires Sage mismatch plus the explicit expansion diagnostic for missing!(). matching_preserves_identical_diagnostics_and_output_order builds first/second/first events at one location, matches three markers, compares rendering order before/after, and rejects two markers. matching_snapshot_cannot_hide_missing_diagnostic supplies an empty diagnostic snapshot yet requires the one-marker/zero-diagnostic Sage failure. overlapping_locations_require_global_matching_and_exact_counts constructs a wide first diagnostic and narrow second diagnostic so greedy assignment would fail, then checks successful reassignment, excess diagnostics, excess markers and severity mismatch. nested_macro_errors_match_invocations_and_multiple_errors_need_multiple_markers runs the pinned compiler helper for nested expansion and two same-line errors, requiring two markers and checking the exact one-marker/two-diagnostic failure after removal. primary_spans_and_ancestry_match_but_labels_and_children_do_not asserts one event despite child diagnostics, two events for duplicate top-level JSON, and rejection of an unmatched locationless event. invalid_source_reaches_sage supplies a body type mismatch and explicit diagnostic snapshot through the normal harness. signature_diagnostics_are_retained_once has two callers of one erroneous signature but expects one marker and one diagnostic. unused_import_is_checked expects unresolved-import diagnostics without consumers. malformed_body_is_not_silently_accepted requires Sage's source-diagnostic mismatch rather than silent acceptance of malformed syntax. These jointly exercise source stages, repeated demand, duplicate event multiplicity, global assignment, exact counts, severity, snapshot independence and output-order preservation. No concrete defect or required edit found; checker expression semantics themselves are outside this collection/matching review.
